title: Senior Manager Data Science
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Manager of Data Science.

  • Are you an experienced leader in Data Science ready for your next-level adventure?
  • Does the thought of working with one of the most comprehensive employment data sets in the world excite you?
  • Are you inspired by transformation and making an impact on the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you a technologist first and foremost who approaches every problem wearing that hat while going out of your way to champion creativity and build diverse, productive, and engaged teams?

IMPORTANT: Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location, It is necessary to live nearby.

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you'll have access to the most unique and one of the largest HCM data sets and do exploratory analysis to understand if it meets project requirements. It's more than digits and dials - you're making huge decisions that impact millions of customers.

Every day you'll work with multiple stakeholders to identify, design, develop and implement advanced AI and machine learning projects that influence daily life of working people. You'll work with your team to provide, interpret, and predict necessary metrics for decision-making. You'll code with machine learning tools like Python, R, and Scala to synthesize millions of data sets into patterns that answer ad hoc requests and then use Tableau for data visualization. You will create models that guide professional through daily working decisions related to every aspect of working life.

To thrive in this career, you should know how to identify errors and reactively fix them. You'll need to have some formal education in quantitative analytics and know design patterns and data structures. You have the skills to create new models using the technologies above. You will coach and mentor junior data scientists with different strengths to solve various problems with different methodologies and analyses. But given the scale of our data sets and the complex problems we give you to solve, you will stay challenged and engaged with years of exciting projects ahead—all while growing your skills and progressing in a rewarding career.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Setup, Build and Grow the Team. You will work in close collaboration with the USA Data Science and Machine Learning team to setup the goals and roadmap to assemble a world-class team in close alignment with the company’s OKRs.
  • Own and Manage Projects. You will identify, design, develop, and implement advanced analytical projects.
  • You will design, implement and deploy high-performing machine learning/AI models and create API endpoints in AWS.
  • Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modeling. You bring prior experience to the role of formulating problems, extracting & analyzing data from multiple systems, summarizing critical findings/insights, and developing a compelling visual representation of analyses with actionable recommendations—this will set you up for success on Day 1. You will interact with developer, UX designer, product manager, and senior executives to understand problem domain, project requirements, users experience and demonstrate model performance and its business value
  • Limitless Possibilities. You will continue learning and discovering new ways to leverage ADP data to create new products and services and find more insights. You are passionate about learning and applying new techniques within data science that leads to innovations.
  • Collaboration and Communication. You'll be part of a collaborative team, listening to needs, then finding and sharing solutions. You're comfortable and skilled at presenting to both peers and leadership on your projects and findings.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • PhD in quantitative area and 8+ years’ experience in Data Science or related field is required, with at least 4 years’ experience as a Team Leader.
  • Prior experience in Python, SQL, LMM, IA and distributed computing tools such as Databricks, AWS or other Cloud platforms; Well versed with Scikit-learn, PyTorch or other machine learning libraries and platforms.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

title: Frontend Developer (Angular)
description:
In SOTEC Consulting - Astek Group, we are seeking an Angular Front-End Developer with strong experience building real-time, data-driven web applications. The ideal candidate is a frontend specialist with deep expertise in Angular, complemented by hands-on experience as a Java developer working with APIs and microservices.

If you enjoy delivering high-performance, scalable user interfaces in technically challenging environments, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain web applications using modern Angular .
  • Collaborate with backend teams and contribute to the development and integration of Java-based APIs and microservices .
  • Ensure smooth communication between front-end and backend services (RESTful APIs, JSON, etc.).
  • Optimize application performance for speed and scalability, especially in data-intensive or real-time scenarios.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to real-time rendering and UI responsiveness .
  • Stay updated on the latest trends in both frontend and backend development.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of professional experience in front-end development with Angular .
  • Experience implementing real-time data features (e.g., ag-Grid or similar tools).
  • Hands-on experience as a Java developer , especially with microservices (Spring Boot or similar frameworks).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 .
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with JSON.
  • Familiarity with responsive and adaptive design principles.
  • Experience using version control systems ( Git ).
  • Strong communication skills in English (minimum B2 level) .

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with state management libraries ( NgRx, Akita , etc.).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies ( Docker, Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Charts ).
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience in financial services or other real-time, data-intensive industries.
  • Interest or experience in UX design and tools like Figma or Adobe XD .
  • Strong communication skills in Spanish .

description:

Ready to Make an Impact?


If you are excited by the prospect of developing cutting-edge digital experiences and meet the essential criteria, we encourage you to submit your CV today. Join our Client's journey to innovate and shape the future of online content delivery.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an Integration Engineer who is responsible for driving and integrating customers with our platform and products.

Externally, you’ll be interfacing with enterprise eCommerce merchants who are looking to reduce online fraud rates, increase their bottom line, and want to start using our platform as soon as possible.

You will be the technical expert and point of contact throughout the E2E integration process.

The goal of an Integrations Engineer is to make a complex process as easy and effortless as possible for each new client. You’ll wear many hats: relaying client feedback and providing technical influence on product roadmap/development, technical ownership of various plugins/extensions, and collaborating with developers to drive commercial issues to resolution.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Have a deep understanding of our system and our product capabilities
  • Provide end-to-end support for new clients during their onboarding process from a technical and operational integration perspective
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management efforts (presales and post-sales) as one of our strongest subject matter experts
  • Build, monitor, and execute a joint integration project plan across multiple clients and integrations
  • Own and improve public-facing SDKs, APIs, and technical integration guides

Qualifications

  • 6+ years experience as an Integrations Engineer / Solution Engineer / Advanced Technical Manager - collaborating with multiple technical teams of an organization such as DevOps or Product, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • An incredibly strong “can do”, and continuous learning attitude.
  • Experience working with databases and querying languages (e.g. SQL)
  • Excel in critical thinking and technical troubleshooting of multi-layered, complex problem statements while maintaining excellent internal and external stakeholder relationships
  • Proven technical background with API integrations; should be comfortable reading logs and source code
  • Substantial experience in a client-facing technical role, including face-to-face meetings and pre-sales activities with enterprise merchants
  • Experience in planning, leading, and executing technical projects with Enterprise clients
  • Collaborative and inclusive team player with superb written and verbal communication skills

description:

Chery is a leading Chinese automotive company with a diverse portfolio that includes the R&D, production, and sales of passenger cars, commercial vehicles, mini cars, specialty vehicles, and powertrain systems.   • Customer-centric approach, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly.
  • High attention to detail for contract validation and documentation controls.
  • Analytical mindset to track KPIs, identify opportunities, and support business planning.
  • Ability to train and guide dealership teams on best practices for F&I processes.

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

Nuvem e DevOps – o Familiaridade com plataformas de nuvem (Azure), pipelines de CI/CD e conteinerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Segurança e Boas Práticas – o Compreensão de autenticação (OAuth, JWT), criptografia e práticas de codificação segura.

Design de Sistemas e Escalabilidade – o Conhecimento de sistemas distribuídos, filas de mensagens e arquiteturas de alta disponibilidade.

Liderança e Colaboração de Equipes – o Experiência em liderar equipes de desenvolvimento, promovendo a colaboração entre Desenvolvimento, Operações e Garantia da Qualidade.

Descrição da Vaga

  • Acompanhar as atividades preventivas e corretivas realizadas nos equipamentos, atentando para a segurança das operações, qualidade de execução, confiabilidade/disponibilidade dos equipamentos e custos de manutenção;
  • Realizar gestão de processos e pessoas, acompanhar e desenvolver o time operacional na gestão da rotina;
  • Acompanhar e tratar desvios de indicadores de manutenção do setor responsável;
  • Supervisionar e garantir a execução adequada das atividades de borracharia, incluindo montagem, desmontagem, calibragem, conserto e troca de pneus;
  • Acompanhar os serviços de lubrificação, assegurando o uso correto de lubrificantes e o cumprimento das rotinas de lubrificação conforme especificações dos fabricantes.

Quais os requisitos?

  • Ensino técnico completo;
  • Experiência na área de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e linear;
  • Desejável CNH D;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Barretos ou Guaíra.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning . The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US

Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE

We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline
  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion
  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach
  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions
  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ years of commission sales experience
  • Strong
  • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability
  • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses
  • Remote-friendly work environment
  • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development
  • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Especialista de Logística - Planejamento S&OE
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Liderar e otimizar o alinhamento de curto prazo entre as áreas de Vendas, Operações (Produção) e Logística atuando como elo central na tomada de decisões táticas, garantindo que a execução do plano de produção esteja perfeitamente sincronizada com a demanda do mercado, o estoque disponível e a capacidade de expedição, maximizando a rentabilidade, garantindo o nível de serviço ao cliente e otimizando a eficiência da cadeia, visualizando um horizonte de planejamento de 3 a 18 meses.

Principais Atividades:

- Liderar o ciclo de reuniões de S&OE, atuando como facilitador entre Vendas, Produção, Logística e demais áreas;

- Consolidar informações de demanda, capacidade, restrições e estoque, garantindo um plano integrado e alinhado aos objetivos da empresa;

- Gerenciar prioridades e conflitos entre áreas, assegurando decisões ágeis e estratégicas;

- Analisar e melhorar continuamente o desempenho dos planos de S&OE, propondo ações corretivas;

- Replanejar produção e estoques diante de mudanças de mercado ou imprevistos operacionais;

- Desenvolver análises e simulações de cenários para apoiar decisões de curto prazo;

- Definir, monitorar e reportar KPIs como acuracidade da previsão, nível de estoque, OTD e eficiência produtiva;

- Preparar e apresentar relatórios e dashboards gerenciais sobre desempenho da cadeia de suprimentos;

- Ser ponto focal dos sistemas de planejamento (ERP, APS) e garantir integridade dos dados;

- Atuar na identificação e implementação de melhorias nos processos de S&OE, buscando agilidade, precisão e automação;

- Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança, Ética e Compliance.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

- Ensino super completo em Administração, Engenharias e/ou áreas afins;

- Especialização em Logística empresarial, Papel e Celulose, Supply Chain Management ou Equivalente;

- Conhecimento com Planejamento de demanda, Logística Integrada, Processos portuários, ERP/Sistemas, KPIs e performance, e Excel avançado;

- Vivência em indústrias de processo contínuo, como papel e celulose, química, mineração, siderurgia, alimentos, automotivo, varejo alta escala ou petroquímica;

- Conhecimento em sistemas de planejamento (ERP, APS) e ferramentas de análise de dados;

- Domínio de processos de planejamento de Supply Chain (S&OE, S&OP, planejamento de demanda, planejamento de capacidade);

- Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão (ERP, como SAP APO, S/4HANA ou outros módulos de planejamento);

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Nossa atuação e cultura

Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

Missão do Cargo:

Desempenhar atividades relacionadas ao ciclo de compras, com foco em projetos estratégicos e de gerenciamento de categoria (como matérias primas, inovação ou CAPEX).

O objetivo é garantir a aquisição de bens e serviços de forma eficiente, alinhada à visão da empresa, às melhores práticas de mercado e aos requisitos de cada projeto.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Seus desafios serão:

  • Conduzir o processo de compras de ponta a ponta para projetos específicos, incluindo a cotaçã, negociação de preços e prazos com fornecedores, e emissão de pedidos.
  • Contribuir para a análise de mercado de fornecedores, identificando novas oportunidades e tecnologias para otimizar os custos e a qualidade dos projetos.
  • Focar no entendimento macro das necessidades do cliente interno e externo relacionadas a cada projeto, garantindo que as compras atendam aos requisitos de qualidade, prazo e custo.
  • Entender todos os pontos que possam gerar interdependência entre as áreas (engenharia, produção, financeiro, etc.) para garantir a fluidez do processo de compras do projeto.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para formalização das compras, como a análise de propostas, mapas de concorrência e contratos de fornecimento.
  • Participar ativamente de projetos de reestruturação da cadeia de suprimentos ou outros projetos estratégicos, conforme diretrizes do comitê estratégico.
  • Conduzir entrevistas e reuniões de alinhamento com as áreas técnicas para detalhar escopos e requisitos de compras de projetos.
  • Elaborar relatórios com a representação do cenário atual e proposta de cenário futuro do processo de compras, identificando gaps e ações de melhoria.
  • Apoiar a adequação da estrutura organizacional, através de análises de atividades e papéis relacionados ao fluxo de compras.
  • Coletar e organizar a documentação necessária para análises de desempenho dos fornecedores e dos processos de compras.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos de sustentabilidade, gestão da qualidade, segurança de alimentos, meio ambiente e segurança e saúde ocupacional.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.

title: Analista Socioambiental Sênior | Descarbonização
description:
Quem somos?

A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira.

Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.

Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.

Sobre a vaga:

  • Gestão de Projetos Climáticos: Liderar e acompanhar projetos estratégicos, como o Projeto ALM, assegurando alinhamento com metas socioambientais e regulatórias.

  • Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi): participar de consultas técnicas e projetos piloto para definição de metas alinhadas à SBTi.
